classification.difficultyReason: Model repeated percentage decay, calculate a percentage reduction and solve a strict exponential inequality for a minimum integer.

content.prompt: When light passes through one sheet of very thin glass, its intensity is reduced by 3%.

children.label: a
children.prompt: If the light passes through 50 sheets of this glass, find by what percentage the intensity will be reduced. Give your answer to 1 decimal place.

answer.worked:
The intensity after each sheet is $0.97$ times the previous intensity. Let $I_0$ be the original intensity.
$$\begin{align*}I_{50}&=I_0(0.97)^{50}\\&\approx0.218065I_0\\\text{Percentage reduction}&=100\bigl(1-0.97^{50}\bigr)\%\\&\approx78.2\%\end{align*}$$

children.label: b
children.prompt: What is the minimum number of sheets that will reduce the intensity below 1% of its original value?

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}(0.97)^n&<0.01\\n&>\log_{0.97}(0.01)\\n&>\frac{\ln(0.01)}{\ln(0.97)}\\n&>151.191\ldots\end{align*}$$
The inequality reverses when taking logarithms with a base between 0 and 1. The minimum integer satisfying the strict inequality is $n=152$, so 152 sheets are required.
